themes.title: Far-right leaders rally behind convicted killer as political symbol
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Italy and Spain are leveraging the case of Mario Roggero, a jeweler convicted of killing two robbers, to push for expanded self-defense laws and pardon petitions. This theme reflects a transnational pattern of politicizing criminal cases to galvanize support for tougher security policies and victim narratives.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni and Lega leader Matteo Salvini advocate for Roggero's pardon and expanded self-defense laws, framing him as a victim of judicial overreach.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox aligns with PP in Andalusia to push for stricter security policies, echoing the self-defense narrative in Roggero's case.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: While not directly tied to Roggero, Trump's administration mirrors this theme by advocating for expanded self-defense rights and supporting armed citizens in crime prevention.

themes.title: Right-wing parties push voting age reforms to engage youth
themes.blurb: Hungary's Tisza party and Italy's Lega are advocating for lowering the voting age to 16, a move mirrored in discussions by other right-wing factions. This theme highlights a strategic effort to mobilize younger voters by expanding electoral participation, often framed as a way to counter left-wing influence.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Prime Minister Péter Magyar proposes lowering the voting age to 16, citing increased youth political engagement and a desire to revitalize Hungary's democratic institutions.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega proposes an inquiry into banning social media for minors under 15, indirectly engaging youth policy debates and aligning with broader right-wing efforts to shape youth participation.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: While not directly advocating for voting age reforms, PiS's internal debates over youth engagement and party restructuring reflect a broader focus on mobilizing younger demographics.

themes.title: Internal divisions fracture right-wing coalitions
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties across Europe and the Americas are experiencing internal fractures, with leadership conflicts and ideological splits threatening their unity. This theme underscores the fragility of right-wing coalitions as they grapple with competing visions for their political futures.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Lega's declining influence and internal power struggles, particularly over alliances with far-right figures like Vannacci, threaten the stability of Italy's ruling coalition.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government faces internal conflicts over key appointments and policy directions, with factions led by Karina Milei and Santiago Caputo vying for influence.

themes.title: Right-wing leaders exploit crime and security concerns
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties in Italy, Spain, and the U.S. are amplifying crime and security narratives to justify stricter policies, including expanded self-defense laws and crackdowns on immigration. This theme reflects a transnational strategy to rally support by portraying their nations as under siege from crime and external threats.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni and Salvini use the Roggero case to push for expanded self-defense laws and stricter security measures, framing Italy as facing rising crime threats.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox leverages wildfire incidents and immigration concerns to advocate for stricter security policies, including opposition to migrant rights and climate regulations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's administration focuses on crime and immigration crackdowns, including stricter Medicaid and SNAP fraud enforcement, to appeal to voter concerns over security.

themes.title: Trump’s election fraud claims dominate global right-wing discourse
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's persistent allegations of election fraud continue to resonate across right-wing movements globally, influencing political narratives in the U.S., UK, and Poland. This theme highlights how Trump's rhetoric shapes transnational right-wing discourse, often serving as a rallying cry for voter integrity concerns.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump's claims of election fraud remain central to his political messaging, with his administration pushing for stricter voter ID laws and investigations into alleged irregularities.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage and Reform UK amplify Trump's election fraud claims, using them to justify calls for electoral reform and stricter immigration policies.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS echoes Trump's rhetoric, questioning the legitimacy of Poland's 2023 elections and advocating for stricter electoral oversight to prevent alleged fraud.
